semantics: expected_status (mention) and expected_suggestion (skill) are the résumé-side states under revision 4. They are a separate measure of suggestion quality. They do not redefine the fixture's gold found-set, which stays the record of what the person has and is kept unchanged as oracle_answer. 'unresolved' is never a passing classification: the résumé alone decides nothing and the user is asked. source_test names the original test. classification 'usefulness_loss' marks a record whose original value was affirmed or found; 'conservative' marks one whose original value was negated, hypothetical or not_found. source_sha256 is the sha256 of the file's blob at base_commit.
